slides.headline: YOUR GOVERNMENT JUST HIRED ELON MUSK'S AI TO ANSWER YOU

caption:
Elon Musk's Grok now answers your questions on America.gov, the U.S. government's official AI website.

The U.S. launched America.gov, where you type a question about your taxes, benefits, or immigration status and AI answers you from official government sources. U.S. Chief Design Officer Joe Gebbia confirmed both Grok and Google's Gemini power it. The announcement called it "a major milestone for Grok," framing a public service as a private company's win. Every question you ask your own government now goes through Elon Musk's AI first.

Governments and businesses are both racing to put AI in front of users. Nobody is asking out loud who actually controls what it says. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you how to set up AI that answers your customers the same way.

Sources: cb_doge on X
